The Stop decision is printed before delivery is recorded; a hook killed at its 3 s Stop budget re-emits the same request at the next guard-free Stop (a Stop that follows a delivered block carries stop_hook_active and emits nothing), so an unattended worker may need another user turn or an attach
An absent, malformed or over-bound Stop payload is treated as stop_hook_active (no block); a delivery receipt confirms only its exact request and attempt
Delivery through the Stop seam requires jq in the worker's PATH; without it the guard can never be cleared and the request stays queued
